Application Data.NAME: Green Valley Convenience Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Valley Convenience Store offers a wide range of everyday necessities including snacks, beverages, personal care items, and household products. The store features a selection of pre-packaged food items, such as sandwiches and salads, as well as coffee and other hot beverages. We prioritize customer convenience and satisfaction with a well-organized layout and multiple checkout options. Green Valley Convenience Store is committed to maintaining a secure environment with strong physical security measures, including surveillance cameras and alarm systems, while ensuring compliance with all local health and safety regulations. Our store operates from 7 AM to 9 PM, ensuring reduced exposure to late-night risks.
